name: Direct Linear Inversion (ART)
aliases: Algebraic Reconstruction Technique (ART) - Matrix Inversion Variant
definition: Reconstructs an image by treating the scanning process as a linear transform. The forward projection is modeled as a matrix multiplication; the image is recovered by multiplying the scan data by the pseudo-inverse of this matrix.
summary: Direct Linear Inversion reconstructs images by computing a pseudo-inverse of the projection matrix, distinguishing itself from iterative methods by solving for the image in a single matrix multiplication step.
